lead_raw_text:
The structure of Li8Fe4As4O24 (reduced formula Li2FeAsO6) crystallizes in the cubic space group Fm-3m (No. 225) with 40 atoms in the unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies octahedral coordination for both As and Fe centers, each surrounded by six O neighbors, while Li centers show a close-packed-like arrangement of 12 O neighbors. The geometric neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connected across all 40 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner-sharing between As and Fe octahedra, and face-sharing between Li-centered 12-vertex polyhedra and the octahedra of As and Fe.
